latHint: Think a wish-granting spirit - not a light.
pivHint: A LAMP lights a room - but in an old tale, who comes out when you rub the magic LAMP?
winText: Three wishes. LAMP was the pivot - a light to a GENIE.
lossText: GENIE - a wish-granting spirit. LAMP was the pivot: a room LAMP to Aladdin's LAMP.
